// striped plasma — 20261108-000000-000000-test@1
// Target: three.js ShaderMaterial (three r187)
// Uniforms: iResolution (pixels), iTime (seconds), iTimeDelta, iFrame, iMouse, iDate; fragCoord is in pixels, origin bottom left.
// Sliders: frequency 1..12 (default 5, step 0.1), warp 0..2 (default 0.8, step 0.05), palette 0..1 (default 0.35, step 0.01)
// Provenance: origin agent
// Licence: unknown (private; the author has not chosen one)
// Set sliders through the exported uniforms; do not rewrite the shader maths.
// Made with Shaderbrücke — https://github.com/studioluftbruecke/shaderbruecke

import * as THREE from 'three'

/** The shader's fragment source. Edit the uniforms, not this string. */
export const fragmentShader = `// striped plasma — 20261108-000000-000000-test@1
// Target: three.js ShaderMaterial (three r187)
// Uniforms: iResolution (pixels), iTime (seconds), iTimeDelta, iFrame, iMouse, iDate; fragCoord is in pixels, origin bottom left.
// Sliders: frequency 1..12 (default 5, step 0.1), warp 0..2 (default 0.8, step 0.05), palette 0..1 (default 0.35, step 0.01)
// Provenance: origin agent
// Licence: unknown (private; the author has not chosen one)
// Set sliders through the exported uniforms; do not rewrite the shader maths.
// Made with Shaderbrücke — https://github.com/studioluftbruecke/shaderbruecke

precision highp float;
precision highp int;
uniform vec3 iResolution;
uniform float iTime;
uniform float iTimeDelta;
uniform int iFrame;
uniform vec4 iMouse;
uniform vec4 iDate;
uniform float frequency;
uniform float warp;
uniform float palette;
out vec4 fragColor;

// Slider fixture: a striped plasma whose look is entirely the three sliders.
// @slider frequency 1.0..12.0 = 5.0 step 0.1
// @slider warp 0.0..2.0 = 0.8 step 0.05
// @slider palette 0.0..1.0 = 0.35 step 0.01

void mainImage(out vec4 fragColor, in vec2 fragCoord) {
  vec2 uv = (fragCoord - 0.5 * iResolution.xy) / iResolution.y;
  float r = length(uv);
  float a = atan(uv.y, uv.x);

  float bands = sin(frequency * (r * 6.283 + a * warp) + iTime * 0.8);
  float rings = cos(frequency * r * 6.283 - iTime * 0.5) * 0.5 + 0.5;

  vec3 warm = vec3(1.0, 0.45, 0.15);
  vec3 cool = vec3(0.15, 0.55, 1.0);
  vec3 col = mix(cool, warm, palette);
  col *= 0.55 + 0.45 * bands;
  col *= 0.7 + 0.3 * rings;
  col *= 1.0 - smoothstep(0.45, 0.65, r) * 0.6;

  fragColor = vec4(pow(max(col, 0.0), vec3(1.0 / 2.2)), 1.0);
}

void main() {
  vec4 color = vec4(0.0, 0.0, 0.0, 1.0);
  mainImage(color, gl_FragCoord.xy);
  fragColor = color;
}
`

const vertexShader = `
void main() { gl_Position = vec4(position.xy, 0.0, 1.0); }
`

/**
 * Create the striped plasma material.
 * @param {{frequency, warp, palette}} [options]
 * @returns {THREE.ShaderMaterial} call `setSize(width, height)` and `update(seconds)` each frame
 */
export function createStripedPlasmaMaterial(options = {}) {
  const uniforms = {
    iResolution: { value: new THREE.Vector3(1, 1, 1) },
    iTime: { value: 0 },
    iTimeDelta: { value: 1 / 60 },
    iFrame: { value: 0 },
    iMouse: { value: new THREE.Vector4(0, 0, 0, 0) },
    iDate: { value: new THREE.Vector4() },
    frequency: { value: options.frequency ?? 5 },
    warp: { value: options.warp ?? 0.8 },
    palette: { value: options.palette ?? 0.35 },
  }
  const material = new THREE.ShaderMaterial({
    glslVersion: THREE.GLSL3,
    uniforms,
    vertexShader,
    fragmentShader,
    depthTest: false,
    depthWrite: false
  })
  material.setSize = (width, height) => uniforms.iResolution.value.set(width, height, 1)
  material.update = (seconds) => {
    uniforms.iTime.value = seconds
    uniforms.iFrame.value = Math.round(seconds * 60)
    uniforms.iTimeDelta.value = 1 / 60
  }
  return material
}
